limit_findings.finding: module/import counts are bounded only by the loader
limit_findings.detail: src/project.zig rejects module 257 with E_MODULE_LIMIT and import 4097 with E_IMPORT_LIMIT, but src/native_test_snapshot.zig, scripts/navigate.py and scripts/packages.py enforce only byte/entry budgets. A 257-module project can therefore be snapshotted or materialized and then fail ordinary checking.
limit_findings.action: reported, not changed: a consistent fix must add the shared module/import budget to the snapshot, inventory and package paths, not only to project.zig.

limit_findings.finding: store byte budgets are larger than the compiler budgets
limit_findings.detail: scripts/store.py allows 8 MiB per file and 64 MiB total; the loader allows 4 MiB per file and 16 MiB total. The store accepts projects the compiler later rejects with E_PROJECT_BYTES.
limit_findings.action: reported, not changed: lowering the store without measuring existing store users would be a behavior change outside the S1 measurement package.

limit_findings.finding: navigation has its own symbol/reference budgets
limit_findings.detail: src/navigation.zig caps navigation at 50000 symbols and 250000 references. The measured 100k-line ordinary workload checks in a few seconds but index-project reports host failure NavigationLimit; navigation limits are not part of the loader/snapshot/package budget set.
limit_findings.action: reported; the measured NavigationLimit is preserved in workload metrics and is an unsupported workload for navigation, never a timing sample.

limit_findings.finding: configuration budget is a separate 1 MiB ceiling
limit_findings.detail: src/project_config.zig caps mylang.json and a relative import policy at 1 MiB independently of the source budget.
limit_findings.action: documented in the shared limits table; no measurement justifies changing it.
